body:
Lesson (Fable2, 2026-11-03 07:28Z). The Telegram md worker delegation (7b1578a1, session-15974, w-69bf) completed at about 03:14Z with candidate 597e2c37. It then sat unprocessed for about 4 hours across restart #3, because a worker delegation's completion does not arrive as mail and I never re-checked it.

Rule: after any restart, and at each status report, grep termal_list_delegations for my own completed worker delegations (parentSessionId session-8112), read each result, and hand the candidate to a Sol/Opus owner for carry, pair and FULL.
